items.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of prokaryotic cells?
options: Circular DNA not associated with histones
items.explanation: Prokaryotic cells have circular DNA in the nucleoid region not associated with histones. This concept is outlined in the IB Biology HL subject guide.
items.reference: IB Biology HL Subject Guide - Cell Biology and Genetics
